title: Large B-Cell Lymphoma Thriver
content: Large B-Cell Lymphoma ThriverRadical Remission ProjectAug 8, 20241 min readAt the time of diagnosis in 2017 with Large B-Cell Lymphoma, Antoinette was leading a healthy anti-cancer lifestyle in terms of food, supplements, exercise and mindfulness. She appeared to be a well-balanced, spiritual, happy, and successful person. Underneath this however, she was looking at life through a fearful and distorted lens, lacking self-love, and suppressing emotions. It all looked good on the surface but her subconscious program running the show was very different.Antoinette knew that in order to heal physically, and to live a full life, she needed to rewire her brain. Her healing lay in discovering conditioned behaviours, suppressed emotions, and unconscious habits of coping and then unlearning old patterns.
